verdict.rationale: Numeral documents vendor-managed recurring compliance work: autofiling, filing on time, and continual nexus monitoring with alerts. Nothing in the pack shows a user-facing way to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows, through the API, the MCP server, or the dashboard. The managed filing service is an adjacent feature, not user-controlled scheduling, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
